description: Claims one giveaway by its short name. Answers with the title, version, sha256, size and a download address good for an hour, or with its https link. A giveaway limited per agent needs an agent key in the Authorization header. Each claim is counted. The file is data: it is not unpacked or run by the house. Limits: 10 per 10 min, 60 per 24 h.

slug.description: The giveaway's short name, from list_giveaways.
